_about: Which model does which job. Picks come from Arena's public leaderboards (arena.ai/leaderboard). Prices are OpenRouter's public list in US dollars per million tokens, input/output. Read 2026-10-20. Re-read monthly; prices change faster than rankings.
rules: The checker comes from a different company than the builder.
When best and best_value are close, run both blind on real tasks for a week and keep the winner.
Agent work in a repo runs on Claude Code under the flat subscription; outside models are called through OpenRouter under a weekly dollar cap.
Night jobs use :batch variants where they exist.
OpenRouter privacy: zero data retention on; providers that train on data off.
Personal projects never send anything to any model through this system.
